meta.citations: Every block carries a `_source` key. Full citation detail: phase1-parameters-2026.md and research/*.md in this folder.

fpl2026._source: HHS/ASPE 2026 poverty guidelines, FR Doc. 2026-00755 (Jan 15, 2026); monthly values per DHCS ACWDL 26-01 Enclosure 1 (rounded up)

calfresh._source: USDA FNA FY2027 COLA memo (Aug 21, 2026; FNA COLA page upd. Oct 13, 2026); CDSS ACIN I-40-26 (Sep 10, 2026) Attachment I incl. 200% MCE/BBCE table, CA SUA/LUA/TUA; 7 CFR 273.9, 273.10; ACL 23-60 (MCE + GI); FNS OBBBA memo (Sep 4, 2025). Prior vintage FFY2026: ACIN I-46-25 (archived research/archive-2026-07/)
calfresh.notes: MCE (CA BBCE) households: 200% FPL gross screen, no resource test, no separate net-income eligibility test (benefit formula still binds). Non-MCE (sanctioned member; elderly/disabled over 200%): 130% gross + 100% net + resource tests. Rounding: engine computes benefit = floor(maxAllotment - 0.3*netIncome) per 7 CFR 273.10(e)(2)(ii)(A) state option.

medical._source: DHCS ACWDL 26-01 Enclosures 1 & 3 (monthly MAGI thresholds incl. 5-pt disregard); MEDIL I 22-23 (GI); DHCS MAGI Income & Deduction Types chart (gifts not counted)

coveredCA2026._source: IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-25 (TY2026 applicable percentage table); Covered California 2026 FPL chart (state subsidy: net 0% benchmark premium 100-150% FPL, 3.19-3.91% for >150-165%); enhanced PTC expired Dec 31, 2025; 400% FPL cliff restored

assumptions._warning: ASSUMPTION-LABELED VALUES - not agency-published. benchmarkSilverMonthlyPerMember is a modeling anchor for the >400% FPL case and premium caps; csrActuarialValues are statutory ACA/CA AVs; assumedAnnualAllowedCosts drives the cost-sharing delta and must be disclosed wherever cliff values that depend on it are published.

calworks._source: ACL 26-66 (MAP eff. Oct 1, 2026: +1.8% per AB 152, Ch. 26, Stats. 2026; replaces the ACL 24-55 Oct 2024 schedule); ACL 26-39 (MBSAC eff. Jul 1, 2026); ACL 21-130 ($600 EID + 50%); ACL 25-61 (IRT); ACL 25-65 (resources); ACL 24-09 + WIC 11157(e) (GI exempt); ACL 26-62 (FFY2027 IRT, eff. Oct 1, 2026); ACL 26-56 (resource limit $13,003/$19,505 eff. Jan 1, 2027 - scheduled, not yet applied)

mapIncrease2026.status: applied 2026-10-26: map{} holds the published ACL 26-66 tables; factor kept for reference only (do not also apply)

calworks.notes: Grant = MAP(region, exemptStatus, AU size) - NNI; NNI = countable unearned + 0.5*max(0, earned - 600). Recipient rules modeled (steady state). GI payments (program-based unconditional cash, any funding source) exempt as income AND resources per WIC 11157(e)/ACL 24-09. Mixed-status deeming approximated via MBSAC differential (MPP 44-133.2) - flagged approximate.

ctc._source: OBBBA (P.L. 119-21) sec. 70104; Rev. Proc. 2024-40 sec. 2.05; Rev. Proc. 2025-32 sec. 2.05; 26 USC 24(d); IRS CTC page rev. Mar 3, 2026
ctc.ssnRules: Taxpayer (or one spouse on MFJ) and each qualifying child need work-valid SSNs. Both-ITIN parents: no CTC/ACTC. ITIN child: ODC only.

caleitc._source: FTB 2025 3514 booklet (658-row table extracted to caleitc-table-2025.json); FTB CalEITC eligibility page upd. 4/16/2026; R&TC 17052; AB 1876 (ITIN eligibility)

yctc._source: FTB YCTC page + 2025 FTB 3514 instructions Lines 25-27

section8._source: 24 CFR 5.609/5.611/5.628/5.630/982.503/982.505 (eCFR, post-HOTMA); PIH 2024-38 (income rules live Jul 1, 2025); PIH 2026-15 (deductions Jan 1, 2027); HUDUSER CY2026 indexed values; HUD PD&R GI FAQ Sept 2023; FY2027 FMR Schedule (huduser.gov FY2027_FMR_Schedule.pdf; FR Doc. 2026-17891, eff. Oct 1, 2026); FY2026 retained for reference

sanJose._note: mandatory-SAFMR HMFA; metro figures are anchors, actual standards are ZIP-level. FY2027 metro FMR fell ~6% vs FY2026
mandatory-SAFMR HMFA; metro figures are anchors, actual standards are ZIP-level

section8.giRule: Ongoing GI counts as annual income unless pilot ends within 12 months of income examination (5.609(b)(24), HUD PD&R FAQ 9/2023), PHA permissive deduction, safe-harbor adoption, or MTW policy. Engine default: counted, with per-scenario override flags.

fedTax._source: TY2025: Rev. Proc. 2024-40 / IRS Pub 17 (2025) as amended by OBBBA (std deduction $15,750/$23,625/$31,500); brackets per Rev. Proc. 2024-40
fedTax.notes: Brackets above 24% omitted (out of modeling range). CA income tax omitted: at sweep incomes (<$80k with dependents) CA liability net of exemption credits is ~zero; documented limitation.

giCountability._source: Cross-program matrix: WIC 11157(e)+ACL 24-09 (CalWORKs); ACL 23-60 (CalFresh non-governmental-funds test); DHCS MAGI chart + MEDIL I 22-23 (Medi-Cal); 24 CFR 5.609(b)(24) + HUD PD&R FAQ (HCV); IRC 102/Duberstein + 26 USC 6409 (tax)
